scope: Three accessed primary sources; absence means not available in the accessed public documents, not proof no author data exist

sources.source_type: Human heterogeneous PDL-cell collagen construct between silicone posts
sources.donor_count_basis: Main article Isolating PDL Cells describes one healthy donor's premolars; supplement not obtained
sources.cell_identity: Heterogeneous PDL population; fibroblast/MSC-associated expression does not establish a purified PDLSC cohort
sources.niche_context: Collagen plus imposed tensile stretching; silicone supports, no mineralized root/bone interfaces
sources.mechanical_evidence: Calculated active cell contractility from post deflection; reported stretch/release and creep behavior
sources.available_numeric_level: Printed baseline group means/spreads and post-force inputs, not individual recovery series
sources.decision: Eligible for aggregate active-force calculation audit; not age-by-niche inference, raw recovery reanalysis or native attachment equivalence
sources.source_locator: Isolating PDL Cells; Calculation of PTC Contractile Force; Figure3D-F; Tensile Loading Causes Biomechanical Creep Response
sources.access_limit: Main article HTML retained. XML HTTP500; PMC supplement response was1816-byte HTML challenge, publisher supplement HTTP403; no DOCX/source trajectories inspected. No bypass/retry/contact.

sources.source_type: Native extracted human bone-PDL-tooth slices, passive uniaxial tensile testing
sources.cell_identity: Native tissue, not a stem-cell construct
sources.niche_context: Intact native attachment context before sectioning; repeated mechanical loading in ex-vivo fixture
sources.mechanical_evidence: Six aggregate E1/E2 and bilinear transition-strain rows across coupled peak-force/loading-rate regimes
sources.available_numeric_level: Source Table1/2; SD convention from Figure6. Individual ages, donor-to-tooth-to-slice crosswalk and raw curves unavailable
sources.bilateral_anatomy_context: Bone-PDL-tooth complex present; no same-unit insertion quantification is provided with the numerical summary rows
sources.decision: Eligible only as a separate passive-native aggregate reference; not a donor-age effect, regenerated attachment or matched construct calibration
sources.source_locator: Specimen preparation, Stress-strain data analysis, Table1, Table2, Figure6 caption
sources.access_limit: Primary XML retained; availability statement generically declares data/material available without a numerical donor-level deposit or crosswalk; no independent raw donor mechanics located in this bounded source set

sources.source_type: Young human PDLSC niche-mechanics cultures plus separate rat delayed-replantation experiment
sources.cell_identity: Human periodontal-ligament stem-cell preparations; source passages3-5
sources.niche_context: Hydrogel relaxation and stiffness vary together; static versus cytomechanical-loading context; human-cell assays distinct from rat histology
sources.mechanical_evidence: Material rheology and cellular responses; rat replantation histology/adverse healing, not same human construct attachment load transfer
sources.available_numeric_level: Article plots/summaries; underlying supporting data available from author on request
sources.decision: Context for mechanical niche qualification; no aggregate endpoints pooled into construct/native comparison; no human age or permanent-position inference
sources.source_locator: hPDLSC Culture, Figures1-7, In Vivo Experiments, Data Availability Statement
sources.access_limit: Primary XML retained; no author request or new supplement retrieval; histological integration is not counted as physiological recovery/durable bilateral insertion

next_discriminant: A public same-construct crosswalk linking exact human cell-donor age/identity, independently varied niche, both mineralized insertion interfaces, geometry-normalized passive mechanical response and measured recovery; donor is the biological unit. Durable original tooth pose and gum/pulp outcomes require a separate orthotopic endpoint, not construct force.
